posts.cooked:
I’m having an issue where the “look at” mode for the cursor seems to activate randomly, especially if I have clicked on something outside the client and then come back. Sometimes it will happen when I’m just rotating the camera though so I’m not sure what conditions are causing it.

The other issue I’m having is switching between clients that are stacked on the same screen. Sometimes it won’t let me switch between them and keeps pulling the same one to the top. I have to click the stop client button on the launcher for the one I want and the quit prompt forces it to the top.

Edit: I tried putting the clients on separate monitors and it seems like there’s a severe delay before it will switch focus properly, if it does it at all without forcing it with the quit method I mentioned.

Edit 2: someone in this thread recommended disabling discord overlay to fix the client focus issue. So far it seems to be working.
